mentions.name: Dancing Mouse
mentions.description: A discovery game built around 53 creature-like patterns that emerged from a mathematical equation visualization tool. The creatures, which appear alive, emerge from parametric equations traced by mouse cursor movement. Built in Autoit, with a playtest version being polished toward a public demo; the raw equations are planned for public release later.
mentions.audience: Others who can share the discovery experience of the creatures
mentions.source_excerpt: So I decided to build a game around these creatures to create a discovery experience that others can have as well, with the only language I knew well, Autoit.
